title: Te Reo i ngā Oneone Tawhito
intro: I roto i ngā karere tuatahi a Allah, i reira tētahi tangata nona te ingoa e kitea poto ana engari he mea nui i roto i te Quran. I ora tēnei tangata i mua noa atu i te tononga mai o ngā poropiti nunui, ā, i mōhiotia ia mō tōna pono me tōna manawanui. He poto noa iho tā rātou kōrero engari kei roto tonu i ngā tuhinga mutunga kore tō rātou taonga tuku iho. Ko wai tēnei wairua rangatira?
clues: Ko ahau tētahi o ngā karere tuatahi, he poto noa ngā whakahuahua engari he nui te tikanga i roto i te Quran.
I tautuhia tōku āhua e te whakapau kaha ki te pono.
E maumaharatia ana ahau i roto i te pukapuka a Allah i roto i te hunga i u, i manawanui.
He torutoru noa ngā whiti poto o te Quran e kōrero ana i taku kōrero.
I whakahonoretia ahau e Allah i tētahi ara nōku anake, kāore i rite ki ētahi atu poropiti.
I whakaarahia ahau ki tētahi tūranga teitei, he honore nui rawa atu i roto i te Quran.
